novelty_flags.label: thm:supervised-boundary
novelty_flags.one_line: This is the existing stat_discrete_ate_minimax_loggap matched fixed-overlap hybrid theorem, with the all-d formulation obtained by the risk cap and null-cell padding; retain it as an endpoint reduction rather than a new solve target.

soundness_flags.label: oeq:sharp-annotation-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: “As treatment--covariate information becomes effectively exact” has no specified limiting regime; state, for example, fixed-(n,d) m→∞ convergence to R_epsilon^known(n,d), plus any uniform triangular-array condition actually needed.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 9--10, Theorem 2; p. 13, Theorem 5; p. 4, Assumptions 1--3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 is a lower bound of order d^2/(n^2 log^2 n)+1/n for d≲n log n; Theorem 5 concerns known uniform P_X and still finds constant lower risk in a large-d regime; consistency, positivity, and no unmeasured confounding are stated as identification assumptions.
Theorem 2.1 gives a high-level nuisance-error stochastic expansion; Corollary 2.1 obtains the root-n limit under the stated large-unlabeled/propensity conditions.
The paper treats a two-sample labeled/unlabeled setting, gives a two-stratum efficiency bound, and proves asymptotic normality with fixed stratum proportions and nuisance conditions.

The paper studies ATE estimation with a small gold-standard outcome-labeled chart-review sample and auxiliary EHR features, develops a robust locally efficient semi-supervised estimator, and includes an inflammatory-bowel-disease application.

source_verification_receipts.version: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 61(5), 2015; public PMC author manuscript
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper splits nonsmooth and smooth regions, uses unbiased best-polynomial estimation in rare cells, and uses a bias-corrected plug-in rule in the smooth region.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv preprint corroborating IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 62(6), 2016; IEEE primary text inaccessible
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The public preprint uses best polynomial approximation for the estimator and moment-matched randomized distributions for the minimax lower bound; no flag relies on a version-sensitive formula comparison.
